assumptions.DUPLICATES: capacity only, never demand (round 7, #230): a product's demand is modelled once; its slots pool their stock and split its sales by capacity, so a second slot adds sales only when the product's demand between Friday refills is more than one slot holds. Replaces DUP_DECAY=0.75 (rounds 2-6)
assumptions.CATEGORY_COUNT: CAT_FREE/CAT_DECAY count distinct products in a category, not slots (round 7)
assumptions.refill: to fill_to every Friday ~3 PM; half of Friday's demand before
assumptions.profit: units sold x (price/1.08 - expected unit cost); unsold stock at cost; minus $1/week model spend; no midweek visits
